full_judgment: 3. The suit was contested by defendant Nos. 4 and 5 (by filing two separate written Statements. The case of the defendant No. 4 is that one Mohiuddin ,took lease of the suit property from Jotish Chandra Mukharjee in the benaini of his brother's wife, Fatima Hossain, Mohiuddin filed Title Suit No 55 of 1963 against Jotish Chandra and got a compromise decree. Mohiuddin, subsequently filed another Title Suit No. 420 of 1963 against Fatima Hossain as she refused to execute a deed of release which ended in a compromise decree. Thereafter Mohiuddin got his name mutated in the S.A. khatian in respect of a land and after acquisition by the Government of 15 decimals he continued to process the remaining 24 decimals which he sold it to defendant No. 4 by a registered kabala dated. The defendant No. 4 while in procession of the suit land went to Pakistan during the war keeping the suit land in occupation of his Darwan. After independence of Bangladesh the plaintiffs took forcible occupation' of the stilt land from his Darwan and are in Unauthorised occupation of the Suit land.
